verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs almost into the CTA pill with no gutter, and the CTA sits jammed against the right edge. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon has shrunk to a tiny tag stuck below the legal line, and the legal line is nearly as big as the subhead, so the hierarchy is weak. B: the left-to-right order works (headline, then product, then CTA) and there is clear space between groups. But the legal text is centred under left-aligned copy and wraps with an orphaned 'Co., 2026.', the sale tag is a tiny afterthought near the bottom-right edge, and the bottle floats in the middle with dead space around it.
